chunks: So your Lord has decreed: Do not worship anyone but Him, and be good to your parents. If one or both of them grow old in your presence, do not say fie to them, nor reprove them, but say gentle words to them.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific behavioral prohibitions and commands regarding elderly parents in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often cited as the foundational text for 'Ihsan bil-Walidayn' (kindness to parents), linking filial piety directly to Tawhid (monotheism) as a primary duty. The prohibition of 'Uff' (the slightest sigh of annoyance) highlights the high status of parents, emphasizing that even minor impatience is a breach of respect. This commandment is frequently contextualized with the Prophet's teachings on the sanctity of the mother, reinforcing the practical application of this divine decree in daily life.
